My only regret playing this game is that I didn't discover it sooner. One of the best co-op games currently out there, and an absolute joy to play with friends. It is obvious that the developers of this game made a game that they wanted to play, and it absolutely shows with the new updates they've added, especially when the new weapons are simply homages to older FPS weapons. (smart rifle from titanfall, sludge gun from unreal, plasma rifle from doom, etc)

The devs also play their own game, which by itself is a huge achievement in today's video game industry. They stream on twitch, and often share unreleased content in these streams. Also recently added modding, which is never a bad thing.

This game is absolutely fantastic. I cannot recommend it enough

"What is the difference between Rock & Stone?"

Rocks are most commonly found in the crust of the earth but can also be found, in the form of cliffs and other manifestations, on the surface as well. Rock is made up of stone and another material called mineral matter.

Stone is referred to as a material made of non-metallic rock-mineral matter. In other words, it is cut from rock. When we refer to natural stone, we’re talking about stone that is quarried (or cut) from the ground. This is in contrast to engineered stone or quartzite which is a man-made construction material.

"So, in a fascinating way, rock is made up of stone and stone is cut from rock! Confused? That’s okay!"
Multiple ways to play, a great online community, no mtx, active devs. If there's anything close to a perfect game out there, this is probably it.

I have absolutely nothing bad to say about this game. For starters, they could've gone the scummy live-service route that Helldivers 2 did and lock all the cool weapons behind in-app purchases or require literally thousands of speedrun grinds to earn enough premium currency to unlock everything through gameplay alone, but they didn't. There is also no FOMO because every season remains permanently playable and can be switched to at any time.

But "not being greedy slop" isn't the standard games should strive for and thankfully this game is simply stellar in its own right as well. It's well-optimized, taking up only 3 GB and running smoothly on my older PC with zero crashes encountered. It's well-polished, with lots of attention paid to minor QoL and UI niceties I'd never even thought of before, such as letting you press spacebar to align your character's rotation with that of the map. And above all, it's simply a really fun game to play with friends.

Ghost Ship Games has set the bar incredibly high for co-op spawn shooters and every game in this genre should be compared to this one hereafter.

One of the best games I've ever played, some best devs I've ever seen, and best community I've ever had the privilege of being a part of.

Rock. And. Stone.

One of, if not THE best coop title i've ever played!

Various mission types, multiple weapons to unlock for each class, Seasons that change random mission events, that you can even go back to. Battlepasses...hold your horses....that are free AND not time limmeted, you can just play season 2,3,4, doesnt matter!
And this game is KEEP GETTING UPDATES AND NEW STUFF!!!!

Cosmetics are so numerous, you can't even count them, you can buy cosmetic DLCs, but they are not cooler than the other stuff you can get (i bought all the DLC's to support the devs tbh, but it's not required in any way or form)

Another big plus is, the game is technically build for mutliplayer, but you can enjoy it solo no problem, either with bosco (robot companion), or just random people.
DRG has one of the nicest, helpful community I ever seen. No Voice required, just Ping or write in Chat.

This game also allows Mods. There are a lot of funny ones that just excels your game to a ridiculous level, like Molly sounding like squidwart, or the resupply shouting "AYO THE PIZZA HERE"

All in all, this game is fantastic an a MUST BUY!

ROCK AND STONE YEAAAAAAH!!!!

Got this game back in early-mid 2019 and played most of my hours in those updates.

Back then the game was quite stable, few things changed and I felt very comfortable progressing through the levels and gaining achievements. The gameplay was great, a few mechanics were abused but otherwise it was balanced.

A big update came which changed everything, Deep Dives. It brought new achievements, missions and LOTS of balances to weapons along with extra upgrades.
This didn't appeal to me for a very long time, the game felt like a new game and I felt like I had to re-learn things I knew.
I quit for quite a while until I came back recently.
Edit: They just keep re-balancing a lot of things, please stop!

I still haven't learnt all the new stuff and the game is still a grind to get all the overclocks however, it's still REALLY GREAT FUN. The new updates have really breathed some fresh life into the game for me, new missions are FANTASTIC, whoever came up with dozer and oil rig needs management to give them some recognition :).

Edit 26/11/21: Another massive great update with new weapons, game feels fairly complete although there is still room for more thigs!

tl:dr If you are just joining the game, you have many hours of fun ahead of you as the finished game is amazing

I bought it because the premise is quite good with dwarves in mines looking for pretties. The graphics and lighting are top notch and its smooth buttery gameplay. Lots of unlocks and grinds for goodies.

But I ran out of ammo. Trying to figure out why while beasties are attacking me is not good. Also, I don't enjoy having to run all the way back to the dropship while literally every single mob they can throw at you is chasing you down trying to figure out which wall you blew open to get back.

I guess that's part of the allure though.

Combine Left 4 Dead, Helldivers, a bit of Minecraft and Starship Troopers and you got Deep Rock Galactic!
As a heavy bearded dwarf you and, hopefully, your team of friends, headed deep down to collect minerals and fight through hordes of bugs!

+ well designed coop gameplay for 4 players
+ 4 different classes with specific abilities and skills
+ awesome horde-style gameplay with random encounters of huge swarms of bugs
+ 4 bioms with completly destroyable environment and awesome atmosphere
+ different ressources and minerals to collect, for upgrading your appearance and gear
+ smooth graphics with a well designed, minecraft-esque style and awesome light effects
+ rock solid performance
+ very stable, with nearly no bugs and connection errors
+ different beards, head gear and armor to unock & customize your dwarf

- singleplayer offers only half of the fun
- only a few unlocks per class. Give us more beards!

9 out of 10 beards - Awesome coop game with great gameplay, awesome levels and a lot of bearded fun!

Seriously get this game you will not be disappointed.

Obligatory Rock And Stone

As a dwarf, you and your squad of idiots embark on dangerous missions to mine minerals for Hank Schrader himself!

The gameplay consists of two things: mining ore and being attacked by hordes of alien bugs that want nothing more than to end your too-short life. Classic. There are numerous interesting minerals to mine like Morkite, which I'm pretty sure gave me cancer from proximity alone.

While the graphics may appear unrealistic by Earthly standards, they in fact capture photo-realistic detail from a distant corner of the cosmos. Most of the time though, the graphics are invisible due to being underground.
The soundtrack consists of mining machinery, your companions screaming as they are eaten alive and "ROCK AND STONE" chanted in between.

This game has taught me a valuable lesson: alcoholism can be very fun. After a long day of swinging pickaxes, there's nothing quite like returning to the space station bar to get falling down drunk and jam out to metal music while dodging flying beer mugs. If that's not a realistic job simulation, I don't know what is.

While the trailers may not seem convincing, you definitely should give it a try.
Reminder: you can refund it before hitting the mark of 2 hours of gameplay if you don't find it fun.

I strongly recommend.

It's a fantastic co-op game. You go into the caves of a huge asteroid, dig for resources, defend yourself from giant insects, and then get out before the timer expires. And best of all, the developer seems to go out of their way to avoid ugly monetisation practises: the battle pass is completely free, and if you don't unlock everything those rewards just go into the standard loot pool. Nothing is lost forever. I've been more than happy to support them by buying all the cosmetic DLCs as a result.

Plunging down into countless depths, crawl through walls like the little gremlin mole to get the juicy ore, counting every single bullet and not saving one for yourself, redefine the meaning of genocide. All that for the sweet mulah. So you can spend it all back in the company store for some sweet looking clothes and some upgrades. Then head back in into the dark hole that you love so much. Welcome to deep rock galactic.

This is a really fun game to play by yourself, publicly, and with friends. The 4 distinct classes, the collection of weapons, modifications, perks,buffs which can drastically change how you play, can provide quite a variety of experiences which are further expanded with the different regions and mission modifiers.

This is a strong recommendation for people to jump in and have fun.

A very fun co-op shooter. Every class is usefull and has it's place and the procedural generated maps create different missions every time.

The season 1 upgrade added a bit more complication (which then only gives clothes) but added some nice and challenging extra content.

Be aware that it takes a lot of grinding to get the weapon upgrades you want, but every step of it is enjoyable. But 200hrs and I still don't have the nuke :D.

This is a game that will never get old, at least to me. With badass randomly generated caves that are shitloads of fun to explore and interesting classes each with their own weapons and play styles it's really something for everyone as there is no bad/unfun class to play. The developers tend to listen to the community and don't plan on stopping that or leaving the game behind any time soon. Enough now, go rock some stone!

Friend introduced me to this game - it was awkward at first - then it became addicting.

Same studio that brought me Satisfactory - and enjoyed Survivors version.

Graphics are not fancy - controls are simple - sometimes a bit weird/glitchy.

But then you get in with your friend - find a big giant bug that can turn a large area into gold - and both die due to being too close to the explosion - only to look at your friend and you both say "Worth It"

Amazingly enough you can single player it - just need to alter your thinking - there's no pressure to co-op - and there are reasonable solutions to every problem - just a matter of trial and error.

Even for the times I scream at the game - I find it worth the trouble - because it scratches those itches.

No two runs are ever the same - its just enough variety that you find new frustrations/clever ways to get anywhere.

This game rewards you for being stubron - and thinking outside the box.

In a day and age where systems struggle to keep up with new games - most of which is AI Slop or overdone - were simple - and originality in terms of approach - this game checks the boxes.

Where was this game in my life when I needed it?

I gladly give them more monies for the cosmetics - they earned it.
